sentences.en: No one can foresee how that result will turn out.
sentences.zh: 没有人能预知那个结果会怎样。

sentences.en: I don't foresee ever being able to go to Boston.
sentences.zh: 我可预见自己永远去不了波士顿。

sentences.en: The fitting thing was that you should foresee it.
sentences.zh: 你果然预见到了这一点，真是太合适了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：fore（预先）+see（看）→预先看到→预见，预知
